items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: we knew Louis was staying with Tshombe... Tshombe had a big problem with Lumumba... Tshombe was going along with big business

ctx.x: You got to -- you taking all that money; you ain't giving out none. Man, you ought to take some and leave some. That's how he'd talk, you know, and he's talking to Tshombe, and that's how he talked to him, you know. And sure enough, he was right. You know, we didn't realize it. But we knew Louis was staying with Tshombe, so we knew he must have known something, because he stayed at Tshombe's house.

And we were worried about that because Tshombe had a big problem with Lumumba back in those days, you know, and we all felt like Lumumba was right, which now I'm sure we had the right idea, and Tshombe was going along with big business, which proved itself to be true later on.
